notes.title: Dev Update-POWER UPS, SAVE PROGRESS AND MORE!
notes.content: [p]Happy to announce i added new things to the game here list [/p][p][/p][p][b]Save and load system- [/b] So now game gonna save and load progress automatically[/p][p][b]Power ups- [/b]added power ups freezing opponent snail, scaring with bird sound and wind[/p][p][b]Pressing wrong answer now gonna make snail move little bit back[/b][/p][p]fixed bug where player can start answering questions before countdown[/p][p][/p][p]if you find bugs or have ideas how to make game better leave comment![/p]
